stem: What does the line suggest about Anna Maria?

options.label: A
options.text: She is solely responsible for exploiting Wolfgang’s musical talent.

options.label: B
options.text: She is untrusting of those who come to visit Wolfgang.

options.label: C
options.text: She is cordial in order to promote Wolfgang’s success.

options.label: D
options.text: She is hopeful Wolfgang will help the family win a place in society.

visual_elements: ANNA MARIA: [Clicking into role.] It is our pleasure to welcome all into our home who desire to see our talented son.
